servers.name: filesystem
servers.description: Secure file operations with configurable access controls. Exposes read, write, list, search, and move tools scoped to one or more allowed directories.

servers.name: postgres
servers.description: Read-only PostgreSQL access with schema inspection. Lets MCP clients run SELECT queries, list tables, and explore column types without write risk.

servers.name: fetch
servers.description: Retrieves content from URLs and web pages. Supports HTML-to-markdown conversion and raw content extraction for use in AI workflows.

servers.name: github
servers.description: Interact with GitHub repositories, issues, pull requests, and code. Enables reading files, searching code, creating issues, and managing PRs through the GitHub API.

servers.name: sqlite
servers.description: Read and write a local SQLite database. Exposes tools for running SQL queries, listing tables, and inspecting schema against a file on disk.

servers.name: puppeteer
servers.description: Browser automation and web scraping using Puppeteer. Supports navigating pages, clicking elements, filling forms, taking screenshots, and extracting page content.

servers.name: slack
servers.description: Send and read messages in Slack workspaces. Supports posting to channels, reading conversation history, and looking up users and channels via the Slack API.

servers.name: brave-search
servers.description: Web and local search powered by the Brave Search API. Returns organic results, news, and location-based data without tracking.
